issues.detail: Spec only requires a synchronous active-high reset; q=0 and ena=0 reset values are asserted without verbatim evidence and marked uncertain false.
Enable timing relative to q update is not fixed; contract derives ena from settled new q, making carry-edge ena 0.
issues.spec_evidence: For digits [3:1], also output an enable signal indicating when each of the upper three digits should be incremented.
issues.alternative: ena is asserted for the increment performed on the sampled edge: on the 09-to-10 carry edge ena[0] is 1 after the edge, while contract computes from q=10 and gives 0.
